Reason_for_hospitalization: Surgical procedure for suspected gallbladder infection. Patient was determined to have a normal gallbladder during procedure.
Contact_comment: Individual underwent an operation for severe abdominal pain, originally to evaluate for gallbladder infection. Surgery was conducted prior to knowledge of the Ebola outbreak. Gallbladder appeared normal during surgery, and patient succumbed to illness the day following surgery. Several others were in contact with case during operation, including ID 542 who was the surgeon for the operation.
Confirmation_Comment: Individual was buried before testing could be conducted

Location_comment: He worked at Nyankunde hospital in Ituri province as a Christian missionary doctor where he likely became infected. He was later medevacked to Germany and placed in isolation at Berlin's Charite University Hospital
Symptoms: chills, fever, muscle aches, fatigue, nausea
Reason_for_hospitalization: Hospitalized in Germany for specialized Ebola care and monitoring. He shows clear symptoms of illness and is severely weakened, but he is not currently critically ill and does not currently require intensive care measures or organ replacement procedures
Contact_comment: Performed surgical procedure on suspected case (Gh_ID528) who succumbed to illness unrelated to surgery the following day.
Travel_history_comment: Patient was medevacked to Germany for treatment after confirmation of infection. The patient's family, wife and four children, who did not have symptoms, were also flown to Germany and placed in isolation at Berlin's Charite University Hospital, but on separate flights.
Confirmation_Comment: CDC reports the American tested positive for Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo (BVD) on May 17
